title: Wire APVTS state schema and allocation into processor
description:
Modify Source/PluginProcessor.h, Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, and CMakeLists.txt ONLY. This is the phase's serialized fan-in integration write.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp (phase a skeleton)
- CMakeLists.txt (existing juce_add_plugin target and target_sources block for ShredSpace)
- Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h, ParameterLayout.h, ParameterSnapshot.h

CHANGES:
1. PluginProcessor.h: include the Parameters headers. Add members `juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState apvts;` and `shredspace::ParameterSnapshot parameterSnapshot;`. Add a public accessor `juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& getValueTreeState() noexcept { return apvts; }`.
2. PluginProcessor.cpp constructor: initialize apvts in the member initializer list as `apvts (*this, nullptr, juce::Identifier (shredspace::paramids::kApvtsType), shredspace::createParameterLayout())`.
3. prepareToPlay: call `parameterSnapshot.prepare (sampleRate, samplesPerBlock, apvts);` so all snapshot allocation happens here, before any audio runs. Do not add any other allocation to processBlock.
4. processBlock: add `juce::ScopedNoDenormals noDenormals;` as the first statement if not already present, and call `parameterSnapshot.updateFromParameters();` once at the top of the block. Do not add DSP behavior in this task; the existing pass-through/skeleton behavior stays.
5. getStateInformation: copy the APVTS state ValueTree, wrap or tag it with the schema version by setting the property shredspace::paramids::kSchemaVersionProperty to shredspace::paramids::kStateSchemaVersion on the copied tree, and write it to the destination via juce::MemoryOutputStream / ValueTree::writeToStream (or copyXmlToBinary of the tree's XML — pick one and use it consistently in both directions).
6. setStateInformation: read the tree back, verify the tree type matches shredspace::paramids::kApvtsType, read the schema version property, and if the version is absent or unrecognized, leave current parameters untouched rather than applying garbage. On a matching version, replace the APVTS state. This must be message-thread-safe and must not be callable from the audio thread.
7. CMakeLists.txt: add Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp and Source/Parameters/ParameterSnapshot.cpp (and the headers, if headers are listed) to the existing ShredSpace target_sources block. Do not create new targets, do not add a test target (task b.7 owns that), do not change the project identity (ShredSpace, nSpace Systems, 1.0.0, NSPC, ShSp, com.nspacesystems.shredspace, urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredspace), and do not change the JUCE submodule pin.

CONSTRAINTS: no heap allocation, locks, file IO, string construction, GUI calls, or buffer resizing inside processBlock. No third-party dependency. No artist or song names.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h declares an AudioProcessorValueTreeState member and a shredspace::ParameterSnapshot member with a getValueTreeState accessor
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp constructs the APVTS with shredspace::createParameterLayout() and the kApvtsType identifier
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp prepareToPlay calls parameterSnapshot.prepare and processBlock begins with juce::ScopedNoDenormals followed by parameterSnapshot.updateFromParameters()
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp getStateInformation writes the schema version property and setStateInformation rejects an absent or unrecognized schema version without altering current parameters
CMakeLists.txt lists Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp and Source/Parameters/ParameterSnapshot.cpp in the ShredSpace target_sources block
processBlock in Source/PluginProcessor.cpp contains no heap allocation, locking, file IO, string construction, or buffer resizing
No file outside Source/PluginProcessor.h, Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, and CMakeLists.txt is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h, ParameterLayout.h, ParameterLayout.cpp, ParameterSnapshot.h, or ParameterSnapshot.cpp
modify anything under JUCE/ or change the JUCE submodule pin
change the plugin name, vendor, version, manufacturer code, plugin code, bundle identifier, or LV2 URI
add a test target or CTest registration (owned by task b.7)
allocate, lock, or construct strings inside processBlock

allowed: choose ValueTree binary streaming or XML binary serialization for state, used consistently in both directions
choose where the schema version property is attached on the state tree
forbidden: introduce a separate state-manager class or new source files
restructure the CMake target or add new targets
